Advice from my side:
1. Keep about just 5-7 ball pens 
2. Use just 2-3 highlighters
3. Even though you have organized your table you need to remove excessive things.  
4. What book we refer is not important how much we learn, understand, secure marks plays a vital role.
5. Refer your topper notes and your syllabus properly and additional important questions. That's enough. Simply don't gather guides or books. Its not good.
6. Be attentive if you are attending any sessions.
